questions.q: What problem does a permission set group solve that individual permission sets don't?
options: It removes the need for any profile at all
It is the only way to grant object-level permissions
It lets you delete a profile entirely
It bundles several permission sets so they can be assigned to users as one unit
questions.explain: Permission set groups bundle multiple permission sets into one assignable package, instead of assigning each one individually.

questions.q: What does a permission set group's "Outdated" status mean?
options: A member permission set changed and the group's combined access needs to recalculate
The assigned users no longer have active licenses
The group has expired and must be recreated
The group was created in Salesforce Classic and won't work in Lightning
questions.explain: Outdated means one of the group's member permission sets changed since the group's effective access was last calculated.

questions.q: What does "muting" a permission inside a permission set group do?
options: Permanently deletes that permission from the member permission set everywhere it's used
Mutes notifications for users assigned to the group
Disables the entire permission set group
Suppresses that one permission within this group's combined result, without affecting the member set elsewhere
questions.explain: Muting dials back a specific permission only within the group's effective access — the original permission set is unaffected everywhere else it's used.

questions.q: Where in Setup do you find the Permission Set Groups tab for a specific object?
options: The object's Object Access page in Object Manager
The Translation Workbench
Email Administration
Company Information
questions.explain: Object Manager's Object Access page for any object includes tabs for Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, and Profiles that touch it.

questions.q: Where in Setup's navigation does Permission Set Groups sit relative to Permission Sets?
options: Only accessible through the Developer Console
Under Email Administration
Under Company Information, unrelated to Permission Sets
In the same Administration section, right above Permission Sets
questions.explain: Permission Set Groups is grouped with Permission Sets, Profiles, and Users under Setup's Administration section.
